subject: GrowthLane renewal: step-up commit, temporary price hold request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@growthlane.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal pricing & step-up plan

Hi Marissa,

Quick note as we approach our contract renewal: thanks for the partnership — GrowthLane has doubled inference volume this quarter and we want to lock a scalable path forward. We're planning a material step-up in usage beginning Aug 1 (roughly 3x our current committed tokens) and we'd like to align on pricing and an accelerated commit conversion.

Two asks from my side:
- Can Redwood provide a temporary price hold on our current tiered rates through the end of July while we finalize a larger commit?
- Would you consider a one-time bridge credit to offset overage risk during the migration month while we onboard additional capacity?

I've attached a short usage export for Q1 to show the growth pattern. Nina (cc'd) is our finance lead and will coordinate PO timing.

Appreciate any quick guidance — we aim to sign within 2 weeks if terms look reasonable.

Best,
Samir
CTO, GrowthLane

Attachment: growthlane_usage_report_q1.csv (csv, 42KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@growthlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing & step-up plan

Samir —

Thanks for the context and congrats on the growth. This is exactly the sort of renewal we planned for. High level response:

- Temporary price hold: yes, we can hold your current committed rates through 31-Jul-2027 provided we have a mutual action plan and a signed amendment capturing the new commit on or before 15-Jul-2027.
- Bridge credit: we can extend a one-time credit sized to cover estimated incremental overages for your first migration month (we'll size this after a short ops review).

Next steps I propose (quick timeline):
1) Ben will do an ops-capacity read to confirm burst availability and quantify the likely overage profile (by EOD Mon).
2) Laura will draft a short amendment (MPA addendum) with the temporary hold + bridge credit and a DocuSign link for signatures.
3) We schedule a 30-min alignment call with your engineering + finance to confirm invoicing cadence and PO date.

Can you confirm that 15-Jul for sign-off is feasible on your side? Also tagging Nina so we can sync on procurement needs.

—Marissa
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@growthlane.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing & step-up plan

Hi all — quick ops check after a capacity pass this morning.

Summary:
- We can accommodate a phased 3x commit starting Aug 1 with predictable latency in our us-central region if GrowthLane migrates endpoint traffic over 2 weeks.
- Estimated short-term overage risk (migration month) ~ 18-24% above committed throughput under conservative assumptions.
- Recommended bridge credit: cover 100% of estimated overages up to a cap equal to 1.5x your average monthly bill (based on Q1 export).

I'll prepare a short spreadsheet with the sizing model and assumptions and drop it in the HubSpot deal record. Laura — if you can build the addendum with that cap language I think we're good to propose.

Ben
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachment: ops-sizing-memo.txt (plain text, 6KB)

To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing & step-up plan

Thanks — Nina here (GrowthLane Finance). Confirming procurement timeline: we can route PO and internal approvals within 10 business days once we receive the amendment and a final price anchor. A couple of asks from finance:

- Can the invoice for the bridge month be net-45 instead of standard net-30? That helps our cash flow while we ramp.
- We will need a short statement of impact (one paragraph) that describes the credit mechanics for our AP team.

Samir and I are available Wed for a 30-min call; 10:00am PT works for us.

Nina
Finance Manager, GrowthLane

Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@growthlane.com>, Nina R. <nina.r@growthlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing & step-up plan

All — great sync this morning. Follow-up notes and mutual action plan (MAP):

MAP (owners / due dates):
- Laura to share MPA addendum draft (includes: temporary price hold through 31-Jul-2027; bridge credit cap = 1.5x average monthly bill; net-45 invoice term for bridge month) — due 02-Jun-2027 (Laura).
- Ben to publish ops sizing workbook in HubSpot and confirm burst window (Ben) — due 01-Jun-2027.
- GrowthLane to provide final PO intent and legal primary contact — due 09-Jun-2027 (Samir / Nina).
- Marissa to approve final commercial and route to DocuSign once amendment is agreed — due 15-Jun-2027 (Marissa).

Significant clarifications:
- The temporary price hold is conditional on the signature of the addendum by 15-Jul-2027 and on the migration plan described in Ben's ops workbook.
- The bridge credit will be applied as a one-time invoice credit after migration month; Redwood will provide the one-paragraph credit statement for GrowthLane AP to attach to the PO.

Attachments included: draft-mpa-v2.pdf (legal), ops-sizing-model.xlsx (ops), growthlane_usage_report_q1.csv (customer).

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/contacts/GL-2027-017 — DocuSign stub will be generated by Laura and shared in that record.

I'll loop in Legal if we see any non-standard redlines on the MPA. Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

—Marissa
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): draft-mpa-v2.pdf (pdf, 92KB); ops-sizing-model.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB); growthlane_usage_report_q1.csv (csv, 42KB)
